title: Audit log
subtitle: Every state change is appended to a SHA-256 hash chain. Verify it to prove nothing was altered.
brokenHint: A stored row no longer matches its hash. Everything from this entry onward cannot be trusted.
hiddenBreak: The break is at seq {seq}, which is outside the entries visible to your account.

demo.title: Demo tools (synthetic data only)
demo.body: Edit a stored audit row out-of-band, then press “Verify chain” to see detection. Only available when the backend runs in demo mode.
demo.done: Entry #{seq} was modified. Now press “Verify chain”.
demo.unavailable: Tamper helper is not available on this server.

okSub: All audit entries are hash-linked and verified. No modifications detected.
notVerifiedSub: Recompute every hash and check each entry links to the one before it.
exportBody: Download the full audit log with its hashes so anyone can re-verify the chain offline.
howBody: Each entry stores the hash of the previous entry, forming a chain. If any entry is modified, every later hash stops matching.
tamperBody: Any change to an entry breaks the chain and is detected on the next verification.
